इव is frequently used with adverbs, especially with such as involve
 restriction, by way of emphasis in the sense of even or just so, just,
 exactly, quite, indeed, very; मुहूर्तमिव but for a moment; किंचिदिव
 just a little bit; so ईषदिव, नाचिरादिव, &c.; (इव is considered
 by grammarians as forming compounds with the word after which it stands;
